title: Acquirer: WPP Global; Target: Grey Global Group

body_sections.Summary: Proposed merger between WPP Group plc and Grey Global Group Inc
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant markets were considered to be: 1.	The national market for marketing communications services including advertising agency and related services; and 2.	The national market for media buying services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided not to oppose the merger between WPP Group plc and Grey Global Group Inc on the grounds that: 1.	Market concentration levels are not likely to exceed the Commission's thresholds; 2.	Barriers to entry to the markets appear to be low; 3.	The merged entity will be constrained from raising prices by the countervailing and bargaining power which advertisers and media companies possess; and 4.	The market is characterised by strong competition between agencies, including agencies owned by a single parent group.
